introHtml: Cotton pet collars offer a soft, breathable option for dogs who spend time indoors or have sensitive skin. Unlike nylon or leather, cotton is gentle on fur and easy to clean, making it a practical choice for everyday wear. Customize with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a comfortable, branded accessory that pet owners appreciate.
